name: TeamSpeak Poor Existence
description: TeamSpeak Activity Monitor for Geometry Dash

private-info.name: Show sensitive info
private-info.description: Allows this mod to show things like level names in the creator tab for the world to see (no not your password)

idling.name: Show idle status
idling.description: Will change your status to idle when GD is unfocused

show-run-from.name: Show Run From:
show-run-from.description: Show the starting percentage in Discord Rich Presence when using a start position.

show-best-run.name: Show Best Run
show-best-run.description: Show the best record in Discord Rich Presence when starting from 0%.
